remarks: AVAILABLE AUGUST 15th.  Located in the heart of Greens Farms, the home features three finished levels with 3-4 bedrooms and three baths. Inviting living spaces include a living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and a sun-filled den. The bright kitchen offers a breakfast room, pantry, and sliding glass doors that open to the backyard, deck, and one-car garage - creating an easy indoor-outdoor flow ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The lower level adds exceptional flexibility with a playroom, home office or 4th bedroom option, and laundry room. A private driveway provides ample parking, completing this centrally located and beautifully livable home. Minutes to Metro North Greens Farms Station.
